User Story Solution Architect

An AI Solution Architect that turns a vague feature ask into an implementation-ready user story — concrete persona, business-language acceptance criteria, verified components, and effort sizing — in minutes, for any Salesforce vertical or greenfield build.

What it delivers
Build-ready

A developer can start coding without a follow-up meeting — not generic AI prose.

Grounded

Verifies every component against the real codebase graph instead of hallucinating.

Vertical-agnostic

PNM, HLS, Insurance, FSC, Comms, or a custom greenfield org — one engine, swappable knowledge.

Live demo — two runs, one engine
Scenario A — Existing PNM project · ~4 min
"Add a rush-review reason field to the Provider Change form so specialists can flag expedited cases."
Scenario B — Greenfield Life Sciences, pharma · ~4 min
"Greenfield Life Sciences Cloud org — enroll a patient into a Patient Support Program with consent capture."
The point

Same skill, two industries, zero code changes between them. The SA discipline is universal; only the domain knowledge is a drop-in reference file. Grounded and governed (versioned + audited) — not a one-off prompt.

Question-first (5–16 clarifications) Given / When / Then acceptance criteria Graph-verified components Effort sizing (S–XXL) Auto-detects new / refactor / epic / bug
